description: Defines a base class 'State' and multiple derived classes representing different lifecycle states within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace, related to ILifecycleManager. Includes method declarations for handling state-specific logic and retrieving state information.

classes.name: State
classes.description: Base class representing a generic lifecycle state, holding context and state value, with virtual methods for handling state logic.

classes.name: UnloadedState
classes.description: Derived class representing the 'Unloaded' lifecycle state.

classes.name: LoadingState
classes.description: Derived class representing the 'Loading' lifecycle state.

classes.name: InitializingState
classes.description: Derived class representing the 'Initializing' lifecycle state.

classes.name: PausedState
classes.description: Derived class representing the 'Paused' lifecycle state.

classes.name: ActiveState
classes.description: Derived class representing the 'Active' lifecycle state.

classes.name: SuspendedState
classes.description: Derived class representing the 'Suspended' lifecycle state.

classes.name: HibernatedState
classes.description: Derived class representing the 'Hibernated' lifecycle state.

classes.name: TerminatingState
classes.description: Derived class representing the 'Terminating' lifecycle state.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Virtual method to handle state-specific logic, returning success status.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the current lifecycle state value.

methods.name: getContext
methods.description: Returns the application context associated with the state.
